market_question: Will Marco Rubio win the 2028 US Presidential Election?
reasoning: Marco Rubio is a plausible candidate but faces a crowded Republican field and the historical difficulty of a sitting Senator winning the presidency. His 2016 performance was weak, and 2028 remains highly uncertain with potential challengers like DeSantis or Haley. The current market price of 14.2% overestimates his chances, which I would place closer to 8% given the wide field and long timeline.
evidence_points: Only one sitting Senator (JFK) has been elected president since 1900.
Rubio won only a handful of delegates in the 2016 Republican primaries.
Florida Republicans like Ron DeSantis may have a stronger claim to the nomination.
Early betting markets often overprice name recognition, not true electability.
